ENTRY 004

Preparing the public release

10.11.26

Eastern mood (Net Art 02) combines MediaPipe hand gestures with a kaleidoscope, irregular shards, starfields, light trails and ripples. Gentle and still viewing modes offer lower motion. This static release is prepared for GitHub → Cloudflare Pages; the deployment URL and automatic redeploy result will be recorded after publication.
